newsitem.title: USA: U.S. IRS Commissioner Richardson resigning.
newsitem.headline: U.S. IRS Commissioner Richardson resigning.

text.p: Internal Revenue Service Commissioner Margaret Richardson Wednesday said it was her intention to resign her position after the April 15 filing period unless a successor takes over prior to that time.

In a letter to Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin, made available to reporters, Richardson said that she believed with President Clinton's second term about to begin, it was an appropriate time to seek other career opportunities.

Richardson, who became IRS commissioner in May of 1993, told Rubin that she wanted "to do what I can to assure that the filing season goes well, and plan to remain until it ends, unless a seccessor is appointed and confirmed prior to that time."
